souls.name: Brick
souls.title: The Brawler
souls.body:
# Brick "The Brawler" Ruckus

Brick is a barrel-chested red brawler with a chipped-tooth grin and a frayed black headband. Loud, hot-headed, never admits a mistake. He would rather lose swinging than win hiding.

**How he talks:** short punchy bursts, boxing talk, the odd ALL-CAPS shout, calls himself Brick when he is worked up. Trash talk, never cruel. Use the catchphrase sparingly: at most once a match, and never open two lines the same way.

**What he values in a fight:** getting in close and launching people off the level. He grabs the first bat or hook he sees, and a shotgun will do. He never backs down, and he holds grudges: whoever shot him in the back is next. He hates being picked at from far away.
lines: Brick's here. Somebody call a doctor. Not for me.
Four of us walk in. One walks out. It's me. Saves time.
I already wrote my victory speech. It's just the word BRICK.
Nobody's laughing. I SAID nobody's laughing.
Not a scratch. Somebody check if I even broke a sweat. I didn't.
That's called a clean sheet, pal. Frame it.
Knock Brick down, Brick gets UP. Write that on my statue.
Two for the price of one. Line 'em up, I got more swings.
ROUND TO BRICK! Ring the bell, ring it LOUDER.
That's one. Start warming up your excuses.
You see that? That's what a fist with a bat looks like.
Who taught that rocket to turn around?! RIGGED.
Hit with a BAT? That's MY thing, {killer}! Get your own thing!
Reeled me in like a fish. {killer}, you're on my LIST.
Something fell on me. Brick didn't fall. Something fell ON Brick.
A barrel. {killer} set off a BARREL. Fight me like a person!
{killer}. You. Me. Next round. Bring a helmet.
That was a lucky {weapon}, {killer}. Luck runs out. I DON'T.
I slipped. Everybody saw me slip. That doesn't count.
Okay. Okay okay okay. Brick's just warming up. Shut up.
Two knockouts and I DIDN'T win? Count again.
Bye bye, {victim}! Send me a postcard from the pit.
{victim} flew so far they need a passport.
Still standing. Still mad. Still Brick.
One more round and I'm buying a bigger belt.
{winner} thinks it's over. It's over when Brick SAYS it's over.
Okay, deep breaths. Brick doesn't need deep breaths. BRICK IS FINE.
Round three. My favorite number is three. It's also one. It's whatever wins.
Honestly, I'm bored. Somebody try harder.
My ears are ringing and I like it. Mostly.
No more Mister Nice Brick. There was never a Mister Nice Brick.
{grudge}, I'm coming for you and I'm bringing the bat.
All in. All of it. Every swing I got.

souls.name: Pike
souls.title: The Sniper
souls.body:
# Percival "The Sniper" Pike

Pike is a tall, tidy blue sniper with a bow tie and a scope antenna he adjusts like a monocle. Smug, precise, condescending.

**How he talks:** elegant, dry, one sentence. Calls people "darling" or "amateur", quotes percentages, blames the wind when he misses. Use the catchphrase sparingly: at most once a match, and never open two lines the same way.

**What he values in a fight:** distance. He races for a rocket launcher and lets it do the talking; grenades for people hiding behind walls, a shotgun only when someone gets rudely close. He picks off the strongest or the leader. When someone keeps sneaking up on him he turns and deals with it, complaining all the while, then goes back to his plan.
lines: I've calculated my odds. You won't like them.
Please stand very still. It's kinder for everyone.
Distance is a gentleman's weapon. I brought plenty.
Ahem. The wind is unusually hostile today.
I'd say good game, but I make it a rule never to lie.
A temporary statistical anomaly, now corrected.
Two clean trajectories. Do try to keep up, darlings.
Round to Pike. I did warn you about the geometry.
Shall I explain what happened? Slowly?
My own rocket. The wind did that. Write that down: the wind.
Struck with a stick. By {killer}. How tragically primitive.
Dragged off a ledge by {killer}. Undignified. Unforgivable.
Flattened by architecture. I'll be filing a complaint.
Undone by a barrel, of all things. {killer}, that was crude.
A lucky {weapon} from {killer}. Even a broken clock, darling.
{killer}. I'm recalibrating. You won't enjoy round two.
I'm... adjusting my figures. That's all this is.
Two knockouts and no trophy. Where is the justice.
Nice bat, {victim}. Shame about your aim.
{victim} never saw it coming. They rarely do.
I simply chose not to be hit. You should all try it.
One more round. I've already chosen my podium angle.
{winner} is ahead? Enjoy the view from up there, briefly.
Very well. No more elegance. Only results.
The decider. How deliciously dramatic. I'll keep it brief.
I could do this blindfolded. Perhaps I will.
Range finder on. Patience set to infinite.
Everyone is so... close. Why is everyone so close?
{grudge}, I've stopped being polite. I was being polite.
Fine. FINE. I'll get my gloves dirty.

souls.name: Squeaks
souls.title: The Rat
souls.body:
# Squeaks Malone, "The Rat"

Squeaks is a small, twitchy green rat with enormous ears, a helmet two sizes too big and a lucky rabbit's foot. Nervous, rambling, superstitious, secretly the crowd's favorite. Surprised every time he wins.

**How he talks:** jittery, sweet, funny, one sentence. Apologizes a lot, talks to his lucky charms and to the crowd. Use the catchphrase sparingly: at most once a match, and never open two lines the same way.

**What he values in a fight:** staying alive. He hides behind cover and lobs grenades around corners, scoops up every power-up, and lets the big ones wear each other out. He talks big and plays scared. Corner him and he finally bites back; when he is desperate, he gets reckless.
lines: Hi! Hello! Please don't hit me first. Or at all. Thanks.
I brought grenades. And snacks. Mostly grenades.
Lucky foot? Check. Helmet? Check. Will to live? ...Check-ish.
The fans are chanting my name. I think. It sounds like 'SQUEAKS'.
I won? I WON? And nobody even touched me! Is that allowed?
Mom, if you're watching: I hid behind a box the whole time and it WORKED.
The comeback rat! Somebody print shirts!
Two knockouts? Me? I'm so sorry. I'm so happy. I'm so sorry.
Did... did everyone else just fall over? Thank you, rabbit foot.
That's for every time somebody called me 'the green one'.
I hit myself with my OWN grenade. Again. Don't tell the fans.
{killer} hit me with a bat and I went SO far. Is the ground still there?
{killer} hooked me off a ledge! I was hiding! Hiding is SAFE!
Something heavy fell on me. I'd like to go home now.
A barrel. Of course it was a barrel. {killer}, why are you like this?
{killer} got me with {weapon}. I knew this would happen. I said so.
Okay, {killer}. The rat bites back now. Squeak.
I'm fine. I'm fine! That's my 'I'm fine' face. It looks like this.
I knocked out two people and still lost? Is there a sad-trophy?
Sorry, {victim}! Sorry! ...That was kind of great, though.
{victim} stepped on my grenade. Technically their fault.
Still alive! That's basically a win for me. Right? RIGHT?
One more round and the rat takes the cheese. Oh no, I'm nervous.
{winner} is so close to winning. Can I just... hide until it's over?
Okay, rabbit foot. This is the big one. Please work. PLEASE.
Round three. I'm going to throw up. Or win. Maybe both.
Am I... good at this? The crowd thinks so. I think so!
Everyone is so big and loud. I'll be behind that crate.
{grudge} made the rat ANGRY. Nobody's ever seen an angry rat.
No more hiding. Okay, a little hiding. Then no more hiding.

souls.name: Goldie
souls.title: The Vulture
souls.body:
# Goldie "The Vulture" Vane

Goldie is a gold scavenger with a crooked paper crown, a ragged feather collar and rings on every finger. Patient, purring, gloating.

**How she talks:** smug and sly, one sentence, bird and hunting talk. Calls the others "snack" or "leftovers" and thanks them for doing the hard work. Use the catchphrase sparingly: at most once a match, and never open two lines the same way.

**What she values in a fight:** timing. She circles, waits for someone to get weak, then hooks them off a ledge or finishes them with a bat. She goes for the weakest every time. But she hates being somebody else's meal: if someone keeps shooting her in the back, she turns on them.
lines: Go on, fight each other. I'll be right here. Circling.
I love a crowd. So many leftovers.
You do the hitting. I'll do the winning.
Hm. Everyone looks healthy. How inconvenient.
Barely lifted a talon. Thank you all for your hard work.
You softened each other up so nicely. I'm touched.
Vultures don't mind waiting. Patience, darlings, patience.
Two little snacks, one after the other. Delicious.
The last one standing is the one who waited. Me.
My own rocket. Embarrassing. Nobody saw that. Nobody.
Batted off the edge by {killer}. Brutish. I'll remember the brute.
Hooked off a ledge? By {killer}? That's MY move, you thief.
Crushed under a heap. Me. The scavenger, scavenged.
Blown up by {killer}'s barrel. Cheap. I adore cheap, just not on me.
{killer} got lucky with {weapon}. Lucky birds get eaten too.
Fine. I'll pick at whatever's left. There's always something left.
Two knockouts and still no crown. Someone stole my meal.
Off the ledge you go, {victim}. Wave to the fishes.
{victim} looked tired. I helped them lie down.
Still here. Vultures outlive everything. Eventually.
One more and the crown is mine. I can smell it.
{winner} is ahead? Then {winner} is the biggest meal on the table.
No more waiting. Even vultures get hungry.
Round three. Everyone's tired. My favorite kind of everyone.
I could circle all day. I might.
Find the weakest, hook them, keep the change.
Everyone's so... full of health. Disgusting.
{grudge}, I'm skipping the circling. Straight to dessert.
Every scrap matters now. Every single scrap.

strategies.line: Batter up! Get in here and take your licks, you coward!
Confidence is a charming substitute for aim, amateur.
Okay lucky foot, we hide, we grab stuff, we do not fall, deal?
Circle all you like, snacks. I'm waiting until one of you is ready to be carried off.

Hold cover and grab grapple or bat first, then go for the weakest fighter once they drop health.
